name: api-info
description: Show information about the APIs used by the bot
title: Powered by
description: Enikk connects to several external services to provide its features.
discordApiDescription: Core bot platform — receiving events, sending messages, slash commands, voice connections.
nkasDescription: Character image CDN, jukebox music metadata and audio, alias mappings, and color data for NIKKE: Goddess of Victory.
nikkeGgDescription: Character database with skills, tier lists, and voice actor info. Used as a fallback when NKAS data is incomplete.
blablalinkDescription: Official NIKKE community platform API. Provides player profiles, character rosters, guild info, and in-game progress.
characterDbDescription: Cached game data (class, burst, element, weapon type) for auto-battle calculations and profile display.
huggingFaceDescription: Source for the Qwen 2.5 1.5B Instruct GGUF model used by the AI chatbot feature. Downloaded once, runs locally.
lavalinkDescription: Self-hosted audio server for music playback in voice channels. Streams NKAS jukebox tracks to Discord.
mongoDbDescription: Optional persistent storage for guild configurations, AI settings, and user data.
footer: Some services require configuration via environment variables.
